items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Woody Shaw by the interviewee (Teddy Wilson). The mention of Woody Shaw is made by the interviewer, who states 'Woody Shaw was playing the Palace' while describing a visit to his mother. ctx.x: Yeah. We've mentioned about you and the rest of the family, one of the sons, and when you were born and that sort of stuff. (Inaudible).

Oh, I just came back from New York to visit my mother. And she's out -- Woody Shaw was playing the Palace. And a very good bass player named Stafford James. Excellent. The drummer was excellent, too, (inaudible). I really enjoyed that. They played until 4:00 o'clock in the morning. Started at 10:00 and played until 4:00. Of course, I couldn't stay too long.
Would you like to ask your Dad anything about yesterday? I mean yesteryear.
